standard_prerequisites.name: Differential extension to a DP variable
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-extend-differential (same chapter, named; NOT carded -- build-gate exclusion)
standard_prerequisites.use: Extends d uniquely to A(m) after adjoining variables with prescribed boundaries; declared as an external reference, not re-proved (the source proof of that lemma is omitted).

standard_prerequisites.name: Adjoining DP variables, odd and even
standard_prerequisites.use: Supply the divided power polynomial algebras in each degree and the cohomology bookkeeping behind 'H_m(A(m+1)) = 0 by construction'.

core_obligations: Start with A(0) = R[x_1, ..., x_n] surjecting onto S, concentrated in degree 0.
Adjoin degree-1 divided power variables T_i with d(T_i) = f_i for kernel generators; extend d by the extend-differential lemma.

Induction step: pick generators e_1, ..., e_t of H_m(A(m)) as a module over A(m)_0 (finite type), adjoin degree-(m+1) variables with d(T_i) = e_i; note H_i is unchanged for i < m and H_m dies by construction.
Set A = colim A(m); for the Noetherian finite-type case note each step adds finitely many generators.
proof_roadmap: Run the inductive adjoining construction and take the colimit; verify the four listed properties stage by stage.
difficulty_reason: The inductive skeleton of the Tate resolution chapter; the finite-type bookkeeping and the degree bookkeeping must both be exact.
